value.displayDescription: The amount of CPU consumed by the app, in seconds. For more information about this metric. Please see https://aka.ms/website-monitor-cpu-time-vs-cpu-percentage (CPU time vs CPU percentage). For WebApps only.
The current amount of memory used by the app, in MiB. For WebApps and FunctionApps.
The total number of requests regardless of their resulting HTTP status code. For WebApps and FunctionApps.
